body: Raken focuses on field documentation and daily reporting. SiteFlow focuses on cost control during on-site execution, linking every site action to BOQ positions, budgets, and financial movement in real time. The structured comparison below is the authoritative breakdown.

hero.headline: SiteFlow vs Raken: Construction Software Comparison
hero.subhead: Raken focuses on field documentation and daily reporting. SiteFlow focuses on cost control during on-site execution, linking every site action to BOQ positions, budgets, and financial movement in real time.

verdict.name: SiteFlow
points: BOQ-linked quantity recording with no reconciliation needed
RA billing and subcontractor management built in
Real-time labour cost vs budget from verified attendance

verdict.name: Raken
points: Daily reporting, time cards, and safety compliance workflows
Field photo management and PDF report generation
North American focus with QuickBooks and Procore integrations

approaches.label: Approach
approaches.title: SiteFlow: unified financial integrity
approaches.body: SiteFlow connects site activity to financial outcomes so labour entries, procurement approvals, and progress updates feed directly into cost tracking, keeping cost dashboards current as work happens.

approaches.label: Approach
approaches.title: Raken: field-centric documentation
approaches.body: Raken provides a strong field documentation environment for daily logs, time cards, safety compliance, and PDF reports, keeping field teams reporting consistently but with limited financial workflow connections.

whatIs.name: SiteFlow
whatIs.body: SiteFlow is a construction management platform built around BOQ-driven execution, cost control, and live site visibility, connecting scope, progress, labour, material, subcontractor billing, and finances into one workflow.

whatIs.name: Raken
whatIs.body: Raken is a field documentation app for daily reporting, time tracking, and safety compliance, with a North American market focus and QuickBooks or Procore integrations.

faqs.q: What is the main difference between SiteFlow and Raken?
faqs.a: SiteFlow links every site action to BOQ positions and budgets for live cost control, while Raken centres on field documentation and daily reporting with limited financial workflow connections.

faqs.q: Does SiteFlow support RA billing and BOQ-linked invoicing?
faqs.a: Yes. SiteFlow generates running-account bills from verified executed quantities with BOQ-linked invoicing, and integrates natively with Tally and Zoho Books.

faqs.q: Is SiteFlow suitable for Indian and Gulf road contractors?
faqs.a: Yes. SiteFlow is architected for India and the Gulf with INR pricing, RA billing, retention tracking, and statutory compliance built in.
